label: D1 reward-received detector, gated to the middle of the episode
explanation: Fires only at D1 and essentially only when the reward input is 1 (99.9% of activation mass is at D1 with in_rew == 1; never at GO or D2, almost never after no reward). It is not active on every rewarded D1, though (precision 0.23 for phase == D1 & in_rew == 1, which has mass recall 0.999). The firing rate depends strongly on the trial index within the episode: it is rare in trials 0-9, peaks around trials 20-50 (about 2.3x lift), and is near zero after trial 80. That points to a slow drift in the hidden state across the episode, with the threshold crossed only in mid-episode. Restricting to ep_trial 15-59 raises F1 from 0.37 to 0.54 (mass recall 0.81). It is also enriched where value is around 7.5-7.7 and where the policy is mildly a2-leaning. Magnitude: the largest activations are on a reward that follows one or more unrewarded trials. Activation shrinks across consecutive rewards (e.g. 0.99 -> 0.66 -> 0.28 in example windows). Requiring the trial before to be unrewarded captures 34% of mass on 22% of activations. It does not depend on transition type, choice, the hidden good state, or the upcoming stay/switch. Recorded the mid-episode predicate (observed inputs plus elapsed time, no future variables).
